svg.title: apt install urna from urna.dev/apt
svg.desc: urna, end to end: urna setup on an empty machine (scan, plan, the offline embedder payload, the python env, the doctor checks), then urna tui: open a corpus, ask it, read the cited answer, check the install, quit. Steps: 1 · the keyring of the apt index / 2 · the source, signed by that key only / 3 · apt install: the release's .deb, checked against the signed index / 4 · the binary on PATH

g.text: bash-5.2$ echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/urna.gpg] https://urna.dev/apt stable main' | sud
bash-5.2$ sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-
bash-5.2$ sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get
bash-5.2$ sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get inst
bash-5.2$ sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y u
bash-5.2$ sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y urna
